title: Target Audience
structural_summary: Document uses H1 for title, H2 for major sections ('Primary Audience (MVP)', 'Secondary Audience (Post-MVP)', 'User Personas', 'Audience Evolution Strategy'), and H3 for sub-categories within these sections (e.g., persona names or audience characteristics). Extensive use of bulleted lists.
key_structural_patterns_observed: Highly structured 'User Persona' sections with consistent sub-headings: Demographics, Technical Proficiency, Financial Situation, Pain Points, Goals, KarmaCash Value.
Bulleted lists defining characteristics of audience segments.
Numbered list for 'Audience Evolution Strategy' phases.
examples_of_key_entities: User Personas (Marie & Jean, Sophie, The Tremblay Family)
notes_for_ai_consumption: The 'User Persona' sections are ideal for extraction as structured data objects due to their consistent internal formatting. H2 sections are good primary chunks. H3 sub-sections (personas, audience sub-categories) are good secondary chunks. Attributes listed under audience segments can serve as keywords or tags.
